task_description: Replace Pexels/Unsplash stock photo approach with AI-prompted programmatic SVG diagrams. The AI slide generation prompt produces structured diagram data as part of slide JSON, and a new PresentationDiagram component renders SVG client-side. Covers items 9, 10, 11, 52 from the presentation-maker-overhaul ledger.

verification.summary: TypeScript compilation shows 60 errors - all pre-existing (same count on baseline commit b589e77). No new errors introduced. vitest not runnable in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Semantic review completed (v1) with 5 issues found; 3 critical issues fixed in follow-up commit. Remaining 2 issues (PPTX fidelity for non-core kinds, paintDiagram closure coupling) are documented as known limitations.
